# CUDA 13 / aarch64 (GB200 / GB300) dep set. Keep the TVM FFI and Cutlass DSL
# pins synchronized with CUDA13_EXPECTED_DEPENDENCY_VERSIONS in
# bazel/cuda13_packages.bzl.
# Keep direct wheel URLs synchronized with whl_deps() in
# arch_config/arch_select.bzl.
# Matches the x86 cuda13 pattern: only self-built wheels against torch 2.11+cu130.
# Packages that link libcudart.so.12 (flash_attn, flashinfer-cubin,
# flashinfer-jit-cache, fast_hadamard) are deferred. flashinfer-python remains
# available for JIT-backed APIs. Keep these architecture-specific pins until
# ARM and x86 are qualified on the same Cutlass DSL and TVM FFI releases.
flashinfer-python==0.6.9
nvidia-cutlass-dsl==4.5.0
apache-tvm-ffi==0.1.7
# Triton 3.6 supports CUDA 13 ptxas natively; do not inject the legacy
# TRITON_PTXAS_PATH version-spoofing wrapper used by older Triton releases.
triton==3.6.0
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/arm_pkg/torch-2.11.0%2Bcu130-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_28_aarch64.whl
https://rtp-maga.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/arm_pkg/torchvision-0.26.0%2Bcu130-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_28_aarch64.whl
mysql-connector-python==9.4.0

# Self-built wheels against torch 2.11+cu130; SHAs are encoded in filenames.
# The ARM FlashMLA wheel is from a separately validated platform build and may
# differ from x86 until both architectures are rebuilt from one revision.
# These byte-identical mirrors live under the team-managed CUDA 13 bucket.
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/aarch64/deep-gemm/deep_gemm-2.5.0%2B8a4dfba-cp310-cp310-linux_aarch64.whl
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/aarch64/deep-ep/deep_ep-1.2.1.12%2B37fda1c.base-cp310-cp310-linux_aarch64.whl
https://rtp-opensource.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/cuda13/wheels/aarch64/flash-mla/flash_mla-1.0.0%2B92fd68b-cp310-cp310-linux_aarch64.whl
